answer: Locks are published in sable, expire in prism, and kernel lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 26 aliases therefore needs 68 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1352 identities would post 4474 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
